question: 2025年销售金额最高的5款商品中，它们上半年与下半年的销售额分别是多少？（请给出商品名、上半年额、下半年额与全年额）
gold_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) <= '06' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS h1, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) >= '07' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS h2, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT name, ROUND(h1, 2) AS first_half, ROUND(h2, 2) AS second_half, ROUND(total, 2) AS total FROM sales ORDER BY total DESC, name LIMIT 5
notes: Task 13 评测失败自动沉淀；供 Task 14 分析
